entities.name: Atrial fibrillation with RVR
observations: For acute AF with rapid ventricular response and decompensated heart failure, IV amiodarone is a reasonable rate-control option when beta blockers or nondihydropyridine calcium-channel blockers are unsuitable; instability with pulmonary edema warrants immediate synchronized cardioversion.

entities.name: Amiodarone
observations: IV amiodarone may be used for acute rate control in decompensated heart failure when usual AV-nodal blockers may be poorly tolerated; it can also restore sinus rhythm.
